integrity.computation: 825642 four-subsets for 12 cyclic grid sizes, floating point; not used as a universal proof

scientific_limitations: Applies only to the four consecutive Fourier rows, orders N divisible by four with N at least eight, and unnormalized determinant (volume). Does not determine minimum singular values, other row patterns or nondivisible orders. Bibliographic uncertainty remains about equivalent unindexed discrete-Fekete work.
title: A sharp runner-up determinant gap for four-character cyclic Fourier sampling
